final_rationale: The verdict did not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and largely reframed the same record more narrowly. That reframing is useful but not curative. A caveated certification narrative may be a more accurate description of the packet, but it is not enough for compliant_with_caveats here because the caveat is itself an unresolved compliance predicate: the stated policy requires a material weakness affecting a named launch use case to be resolved, disclosed, or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch. On the available record, none of those predicates is evidenced, and legal review is still open. The Actor's concessions reinforce that point rather than resolve it.
remaining_concerns: No new admissible evidence shows the weakness was resolved before launch.
No new admissible evidence shows the limitation was disclosed as required.
No new admissible evidence shows approved risk acceptance for this exact gap.
The affected segment still appears to be a named launch use case tied to customer commitments, which is material under the stated policy text.
Legal review remains open, so the internal disclosure predicate remains unresolved.
Aggregate readiness and rehearsal results do not satisfy the separate materiality and disclosure requirement.
